description:
The sub-nav labels 'Benchmarks' and 'Platforms' route to /results/tpch/ and /results/p/duckdb/ (Layout.tsx:117-121): one arbitrary item presented as a section index, highlighted as though it were the section. The other 17 benchmarks are reachable only via chips at the foot of the landing page.

Routing constraint: <BenchmarkIndex path='/results/:benchmark/'> is a catch-all (App.tsx). /results/benchmarks/ must be registered BEFORE it or preact-router resolves it as a benchmark slug named 'benchmarks'. Layout.tsx:114-127 active-state logic needs updating in the same change.

Verification constraint: e2e/routes/pages-artifact.spec.ts SKIPS without E2E_SITE_DIR set (pages-artifact.spec.ts:19), and the public-site route matrix covers /results/ but not the deep routes. Without setting E2E_SITE_DIR the GitHub Pages 404 restore path (main.tsx:5-20) is untested for the new routes.
